primitives.name: Offside Ball Touch Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: recover the ball on a fumble or a muff, but in no other instance shall a player when offside touch the ball.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{offside}': 'Boolean indicator for offside status (dimensionless)', 'B_{touch}': 'Ball touch event (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Player position is deterministically known relative to line of scrimmage and opponent.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_offside = true and B_touch occurs before opponent contact.

layer2.mapping: Binary constraint function maps player state to legal action space via temporal ordering of events.
layer2.telemetry: Observed offside violations during live play

primitives.name: Penalty Enforcement Rule
primitives.verbatim_quote: PENALTY (UMPIRE, REFEREE) Loss of ball to opponents at spot where foul occurred.
primitives.assumptions: Foul detection is deterministic and localized to a single point.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Upon F_foul = true, S_spot becomes new possession anchor.

layer2.mapping: State transition kernel maps current possession to opponent possession with shift in spatial coordinate.
layer2.telemetry: Ball possession change following foul call

primitives.name: Player Onside Reactivation
primitives.verbatim_quote: A player who is off-side is put on-side when the ball touches an opponent.
primitives.assumptions: Reactivation is instantaneous upon opponent-ball interaction.
primitives.breakdown_regime: T_on_side = false → true upon B_opponent_contact = true.

layer2.mapping: Event-triggered automaton resets player state based on external stimulus.

primitives.name: Kick Completion Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: The player who, standing back of his own line of scrimmage, receives the ball from one of his own side and then kicks it beyond the line of scrimmage may not himself touch the ball until after it has touched a man entitled to get it.
primitives.assumptions: Eligible receivers are defined by rule set; kick must cross line of scrimmage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: K_kick = true ⇒ T_touch must occur before self-touch.

layer2.mapping: Temporal constraint kernel enforces sequential legality of kick and return actions.
layer2.telemetry: Kick return timing relative to first touch
